scope_note: Describes the sections a SOC 2 report conventionally contains, so DriftGuard can parse and analyse uploaded reports. Section ordering and numbering vary by audit firm; DriftGuard must identify sections by content signature, not by position.

sections.name: Independent Service Auditor's Report
sections.author: service_auditor
contains: Scope paragraph identifying the system and trust services categories
Service organization's and service auditor's responsibilities
Reference to Section 4 description of tests and results

sections.name: Management's Assertion
sections.author: service_organization_management
contains: Assertion that the description is presented in accordance with the description criteria
Assertion on suitability of design (and, for Type 2, operating effectiveness)
sections.note: Some firms present the assertion before the auditor's report. Ordering of sections 1 and 2 is a firm convention, not a requirement.

sections.name: Description of the System
sections.author: service_organization_management
contains: Principal service commitments and system requirements
Components: infrastructure, software, people, procedures, data
Relevant aspects of the control environment, risk assessment, information and communication, and monitoring
Complementary subservice organization controls (CSOCs) and carve-out or inclusive method
Disclosed incidents and changes during the period

sections.name: Trust Services Criteria, Related Controls, Tests of Controls, and Results of Tests
sections.author: service_auditor
contains: Management's controls mapped to each criterion
sections.note: A Type 1 report presents controls and the description but does not include tests of operating effectiveness or results.

sections.name: Other Information Provided by Management
sections.author: service_organization_management
sections.note: This section is explicitly not covered by the auditor's opinion. DriftGuard must never treat content here as audited evidence.

opinion_types.name: Unqualified (clean)
opinion_types.meaning: Controls were suitably designed and, for Type 2, operated effectively in all material respects.

opinion_types.name: Qualified
opinion_types.meaning: Except for identified matters, controls were suitably designed and operating effectively.

opinion_types.name: Adverse
opinion_types.meaning: Controls were not suitably designed or did not operate effectively in material respects.

opinion_types.name: Disclaimer of opinion
opinion_types.meaning: The practitioner was unable to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence to form an opinion.

analysis_rules: An unqualified opinion does not mean zero exceptions. Exceptions may appear in Section 4 with a clean opinion; DriftGuard must read Section 4 rather than inferring from the opinion.
CUECs shift responsibility to the customer and are a primary vendor-risk signal; they must always be extracted.
Carved-out subservice organizations are excluded from the opinion and create a downstream assurance gap that must be flagged.
